step: Open Settings, tap Battery, then turn on Power saving.
Turn Power saving back off once the phone is charged.
Go to Settings and tap Battery to see power saving mode.
Open the battery settings screen.
Switch on Adaptive battery so unused apps are limited.
screen: Settings > Battery > Background usage limits > Adaptive battery

step: Turn off Adaptive battery.
Enable Protect battery to cap charging at 85 percent.
Check whether battery protection is currently on.
Turn on Fast charging for the cable charger.
Switch off fast cable charging if the phone gets warm.
Open the charging settings to review the options.
Lower the screen brightness using the slider.
Turn on Adaptive brightness so the screen adjusts itself.
Turn off automatic brightness adjustment.
Shorten how long the screen stays on before it sleeps.
Check the current screen timeout value.
Turn on the blue light filter in the evening.
Turn the blue light filter off.
Open the navigation bar settings.
Turn on Touch sensitivity if you use a screen protector.
Turn off increased touch sensitivity.
Open Screen mode to change the colour profile.
Switch on Edge panels.
Turn Edge panels off.
Turn on Always On Display.
screen: Settings > Lock screen > Always On Display

step: Turn Always On Display off to save power.
screen: Settings > Lock screen > Always On Display

step: Open the Dark mode schedule settings.
screen: Settings > Display > Dark mode > Dark mode settings

step: Turn on Auto dim screen.
Turn on Double tap to wake.
screen: Settings > Advanced features > Motions and gestures > Double tap to wake

step: Open Settings, tap Connections, then tap Wi-Fi.
Switch Wi-Fi on.
Switch Wi-Fi off and back on again.
Turn on Mobile data.
Turn Mobile data off.
Turn on Airplane mode for a few seconds.
Turn Airplane mode back off.
Open Settings, tap Connections, then tap Bluetooth.
Turn Bluetooth on.
Turn Bluetooth off.
Turn on Mobile Hotspot.
screen: Settings > Connections > Mobile Hotspot and Tethering > Mobile Hotspot

step: Turn on NFC and contactless payments.
screen: Settings > Connections > NFC and contactless payments

step: Turn on Data Saver.
screen: Settings > Connections > Data usage > Data Saver

step: Turn Location on.
Turn Location off.
Open Do not disturb settings.
Turn on Do not disturb.
Turn off Do not disturb.
Turn on app icon badges.
screen: Settings > Notifications > Advanced settings > App icon badges

step: Open the app icon badge settings.
Turn the media volume down.
screen: Settings > Sounds and vibration > Volume > Media

step: Lower the ringtone volume.
screen: Settings > Sounds and vibration > Volume > Ringtone

step: Open the volume settings.
Turn the alarm volume up.
screen: Settings > Sounds and vibration > Volume > Alarm

step: Open Settings, tap Accounts and backup, then turn on Back up data.
screen: Settings > Accounts and backup > Samsung Cloud > Back up data

step: Turn off backing up data to Samsung Cloud.
screen: Settings > Accounts and backup > Back up data

step: Turn on automatic syncing of your account data.
screen: Settings > Accounts and backup > Manage accounts > Auto sync data

step: Open Reset options.
Open the camera access privacy setting.
screen: Settings > Security and privacy > Camera access

step: Open Lock screen settings.
Turn on Multi window for all apps.
screen: Settings > Advanced features > Labs > Multi window for all apps

step: Turn off multi window for all apps.
screen: Settings > Advanced features > Labs > Multi window for all apps

step: Turn on app pinning.
screen: Settings > Security and privacy > Other security settings > Pin windows

step: Run Optimize now to free up memory.
screen: Settings > Battery and device care > Optimize now

step: Open Settings, tap Apps, tap Storage, then tap Clear cache.
Tap Clear data and confirm with OK.
Tap Force stop to close the misbehaving app.
Open the app info screen for the email app.
Open Settings, tap Software update, then tap Download and install.
screen: Settings > Software update > Download and install

step: Select Smart View to mirror the screen to your TV.
Change the font size and screen zoom.
screen: Settings > Display > Font size and style

step: Open Secure Folder from the Apps screen.
screen: Settings > Security and privacy > Secure Folder

step: Open Find My Mobile to locate the device.
screen: Settings > Security and privacy > Find My Mobile

step: Open Developer options to check the animation scale.
Change the screen resolution to a lower setting.
Open the Downloads folder in My Files.
Restart the phone in safe mode to test third-party apps.
Press and hold the Side key, then tap Restart.
Force restart by holding the Side key and Volume down for 20 seconds.
Visit an authorized Samsung Service Center for inspection.
Contact Samsung Support to arrange a repair.
Clean the charging port carefully with a soft brush.
Wipe the camera lens with a soft cloth.
Charge the phone for at least 30 minutes with the original charger.
Remove the phone case and screen protector, then test again.
Take out the SIM tray and reseat the SIM card.
Connect the phone to a PC with a USB cable.
Perform a factory data reset after backing up your data.
screen: Settings > General management > Reset > Factory data reset
